item.text: The queue currently sorts priority names alphabetically, so `"normal"` is popped before `"urgent"`. A separate Beacon account override masks that for Beacon shipments. I’m changing the queue to use the service ranks in `policy.py` and removing the account-based batch override so the same priority rule applies to Harbor and Beacon.
